decisions.reason: The Trivital-type supplement range builds directly on the firm's OTC pharmacy channel, in-house manufacturing and quality expertise, so the firm can read early sales results and refine the line rather than abandon it.
The skin and hair supplement has a dedicated page and a clear pharmacy launch, and it fits the firm's consumer health know-how, so it is worth keeping while market feedback is assimilated.

The joint health supplement relates closely to the firm's existing pharmaceutical and OTC knowledge and was actively promoted as new, which supports keeping it within the expanding consumer health portfolio.

The mushroom-based immune supplement lies further from the firm's core pharmaceutical knowledge and gets only minor web presence, so it is riskier, but one year is too little time to judge it, so it stays for now.

The generic valsartan was hit by the 2018 nitrosamine contamination recall of the active ingredient, which lies outside the firm's own sourcing knowledge, so withdrawing it and redirecting resources to sounder generics is the most likely course.
